compliance_decision:
1. Customer identification records should be retained for a period as specified by the Financial Intelligence Centre Act, even after account closure.
2. Section 22 of the FIC Act provides this obligation on accountable institutions to keep customer due diligence records. Additionally, section 22A mandates keeping transaction records related to single transactions and concluded business relationships with clients.
3. Accountable financial institutions are required by law (FIC Act) to maintain these identification and transactional records for a specified duration post-account closure as part of their due diligence obligations under the FIC Act, which is essential in complying with anti-money laundering regulations.
4. Yes
